correctness.rationale: For a primitive two-cycle on connected K_{a,b}, Laplacian conservation forces the two firing indicator sets to be complements; at every vertex exact allowed chip intervals have length the number of opposite-firing neighbors. Counting all labeled intervals gives the stated mass polynomial, with pure shore phases divided by two; mass reflection uses x_v -> 2d_v-1-x_v. For a=b=n the phased trace is n^(2n)tr(K_n^2); triangular polynomial action has eigenvalues (-1)^k(n)_k/n^k and gives exact N_n. Gaussian dominated falling factorial sum gives sqrt(pi n)n^(2n)/4 and local binomial estimates plus endpoint domination yield Beta(1/2,1/2) firing fraction. Boundaries a,b=1 handled. Direct finite counts do not prove asymptotic.
